name: Slano Blato Landslide
zag_role: Geological-geomechanical investigations for the Slano blato landslide
description: Geological-geomechanical investigations for the Slano blato landslide.
history: A viscous earthflow above Lokavec below Caven, more than 1,290 m long and up to 200 m wide, repeatedly reactivated.
facts: Ministry of the Environment and Spatial Planning

record_sources.title: Kinematics of the Slano Blato landslide from remote sensing

specifications.label: Length
specifications.value: about 1,290 (end 2004), Wikipedia 1,010-1,300

specifications.label: Volume
specifications.value: about 700,000

specifications.label: Area
specifications.value: about 15

specifications.label: Elevation
specifications.value: 270-640 a.s.l., main scarp ~640, initiation ~570, Dec 2000 front ~380

specifications.label: Geology
specifications.value: Triassic limestone overthrust on strongly folded Eocene flysch (marl/sandstone), slide mass clayey gravel with blocks

specifications.label: Event dates
specifications.value: 20 Oct 1885, 19 Nov 2000 main triggering, 20 Mar to 25 Apr 2001, Oct 2001 mudflows

specifications.label: Monitoring
specifications.value: GPS and geodetic points, inclinometers, 21 boreholes/trial pits, seismic refraction, rain gauge in Lokavec, discharge measurements

specifications.label: Remediation
specifications.value: drainage trenches, about 200,000 m3 removed, rockfill dam holding back up to 5,000 m3 of debris, two 5 m diameter concrete shafts, Grajšček bed rip-rap

specifications.label: Max flow rate
specifications.value: 100 m/day

specifications.label: Authors including ZAG
specifications.value: Logar, Fifer Bizjak (ZAG), Kočevar, Mikoš, Ribičič, Majes

specifications.label: Remediation, first drainage shafts
specifications.value: 2 hollow concrete shafts, 5 m diameter
specifications.quote: the first two large hollow concrete shafts with a diameter of 5 m

specifications.label: Remediation, planned shafts
specifications.value: 5 reinforced concrete shafts acting as dewatering wells and dowels
specifications.quote: Construction of a set of 5 reinforced concrete shafts

specifications.label: Shaft inflow
specifications.value: up to 15 m³ of water per day per shaft
specifications.quote: Up to 15 m3 of water per day can be collected in one shaft.

specifications.label: Remediation, wells in the upper part
specifications.value: built 2004 to 2007, also act as shear reinforcement
specifications.quote: med leti 2004 in 2007 pa se je v zgornjem delu plazu zgradilo vodnjake

specifications.label: Remediation, barrier for mud flows

specifications.quote: leta 2002 pričelo z interventnimi deli na plazu Slano blato

specifications.label: Historic remediation

specifications.quote: The main remediation works were completed in 1903 and cost 49 857 crowns

source_differences: Elevations differ: Wikipedia 360-660 m, NHESS 2005 270-640 m, main scarp ~640 m.

Main activation date: NHESS 2005 says 19 November 2000, Wikipedia says November 2000. Secondary flows: NHESS says 20 Mar-25 Apr 2001 advance and October 2001 mudflows, record/Wikipedia say September 2001.
Removed volume: Wikipedia 230,000 m3, NHESS ~200,000 m3 (by end 2004).
Length and volume: more than 1290 m long, about 700 000 m3 (nhess.copernicus.org) against about 1,600 m long, total sliding mass of about 900,000 m3 (landslides.org)
First record: event on 20 October 1885 and a debris flow in 1786 (en.wikipedia.org) against 'The landslide was first mentioned in 1887', table date Nov 11, 1887 (landslides.org)
Volume: about 700,000 m³ against about 1,000,000 m³ in Geologija 2008.
